description: drakescale_beast default look, LIGHT proxy finish: the colour is the Pixal3D proxy's own texture (olive / khaki re-toned to the sheet's warm brown scales, copper tips and cream belly; the rebuilt tail painted as dark-to-copper scale rows) baked onto the low (improved/textures/drakescale_beast_basecolor.png); proxy_albedo (white) tints it. No glow (the eye is painted)

proxy_albedo.note: tint over the baked proxy albedo (light mode); white keeps the scales as baked. Sheet chips for reference: 43,36,36 / 72,57,48 / 124,87,65 / copper 188,146,115 / cream 220,187,156 / grey 103,95,98
